lemma checkReal_fixed (j:ℕ)(u:S.Field j)(hP:P.Coherent)(hQ:Q.Inclusions S)
      (hc:Q.Orientation ρ)(he:j ≤ m) : checkReal P hX hS m (sole 0) 0 (d:=fun _:Unit=>j) (sole u)=Q.rise he u:=by
    have hh:bar ρ (d:=fun _:Unit=> j) (sole u) = sole (S.conj ρ j u):=rfl
    rw [checkValue,hh,average_fixes hX hS m _ hQ hP he,average_fixes hX hS m _ hQ hP he,hc.realInc,S.reflect_star, ← two_smul ℝ, inv_smul_smul₀ (two_ne_zero (α:=ℝ))] -- two_smul names?

proof_context.conclusion: For j <= m, the averaged real reader of a single degree-j field at the origin returns its rise, using rotation averaging and the reality laws.

lemma kills_lower (m q:ℕ)(h:q < m) (z:S.Field q): R.cutTest m q z=0:=by
    cases m with
    | zero=> exact (Nat.not_lt_zero _ h).elim
    | succ m=>
       rw [R.test_formula (m+1) q h.le]
       have he: (∑ i:Fin (m+1),Q.rise i.isLt.le (R.cutTest i.val q z))= Q.rise h.le z := by
          rw [← Q.transit R.continuum.laws.toSymmetric R.lifts (Nat.le_sub_one_of_lt h) m.le_succ]
          have hw:= congr_arg (Q.rise m.le_succ) (R.reconstruct m q (by omega) z)
          rw [map_sum] at hw; apply Eq.trans ?_ hw; refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _=> (Q.transit R.continuum.laws.toSymmetric R.lifts ..).symm
       rw [he,sub_self]

proof_context.conclusion: test_formula and reconstruct give the sum of rises of cuts equal to the rise, and kills_lower gives cutTest m q = 0 for q < m.
